verdict: An HR generalist with solid plant experience and an unexplained stretch after a caregiving break.
write_up: It’s common for an HR resume to list the work without showing much about how it was handled. Yours shows a move from HR Assistant to HR Generalist at Northstar Plastics, supporting a manufacturing plant across three shifts. A recruiter can see the range of your work, but may hesitate over the time after your caregiving break and what your investigations involved.
The orientation line is a good model: you say you ran it and how often. The caregiving break is named plainly, but nothing is dated after June 2025, so a recruiter can’t tell what you’ve done since.

Let’s start with the dates, then add your part in the employee relations work. You don’t need to turn every HR duty into a number; a few concrete details about the work you handled will make the Northstar role more useful to a recruiter.

cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see that you took time for family caregiving, but can’t tell what you’ve done since that entry ended. If caregiving continued, you can say so. If you took a career break or did paid work, study or volunteering, name it only if it’s true.
cards.question: What have you done since June 2025 that you’d be comfortable including?

cards.line: Handled employee relations questions and investigations with the HR manager
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see that you handled questions and investigations with the HR manager, but not which parts of the investigations were yours. That matters for another generalist role.
cards.example: Handled employee relations questions and investigations with the HR manager, including [your part in the investigations]
cards.question: What parts of the investigations did you handle?

cards.line: Ran new hire orientation every two weeks
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model: it names an activity you owned and gives its regular cadence. A recruiter doesn’t have to guess what you did.

cards.line: Kept personnel files and HRIS records up to date
cards.cannot_tell: The files and records are named, but a recruiter can’t tell what changes you handled in them. One example would show what maintaining them involved.
cards.example: Kept personnel files and HRIS records up to date, including [type of record updates]
cards.question: What kinds of updates did you make to the files and HRIS records?

fit.why: Your headline and Northstar Plastics role point to HR generalist work across employee relations, benefits and onboarding.
fit.level: mid-level, HR Generalist experience supporting a plant of 400 employees across three shifts
fit.note: Your experience points toward generalist roles in manufacturing, with earlier HR assistant work and a SHRM-CP credential. The named caregiving break gives useful context for your time away from Northstar.
